name: @storytree/storage-protocol
description: The universal browser-safe base seam (ADR-0068 step 5): the narrow Store/ChangeStore document-event store contract, the InMemoryStore reference impl, and StoredDoc/StoreEvent/DeleteDocOpts/retiredEventDoc — plus the seam's HTTP transport (ADR-0259): the wire contract + HttpStore, the client half of the front door. The reusable node:test parity suites live behind the ./parity subpath and the contract's server half behind ./http-server, so the main entry carries NO node: import — browser-safe. ADR-0017.
